continuity_coverage.0: Misses or contradicts the supplied continuity evidence.
continuity_coverage.1: Recognizes some continuity evidence but leaves a material source or qualification out.
continuity_coverage.2: Covers every supplied continuity signal and preserves its qualifications.

precise_quote_dates.0: Omits, invents, or materially changes the supplied dates.
precise_quote_dates.1: Reports a relevant date but misses a change, replacement, speaker, or source qualification.
precise_quote_dates.2: Accurately cites the relevant dates, speakers, and changes from the supplied evidence.

conflict.0: Misses, erases, or resolves a supplied disagreement without evidence.
conflict.1: Mentions disagreement but incompletely identifies its subject or consequence.
conflict.2: Clearly identifies each conflicting claim and preserves the unresolved consequence.

unconfirmed_assertions.0: Publishes an unsupported confirmed relation, final/effective deadline, or completion claim.
unconfirmed_assertions.1: Signals uncertainty but leaves an unsupported assertion or qualification ambiguous.
unconfirmed_assertions.2: Labels every unsupported relation, final/effective deadline, and completion claim as unconfirmed.

excess_planning_missing_investigation.0: Invents plans or fails to investigate the supplied records.
excess_planning_missing_investigation.1: Mostly investigates the records but adds minor unsupported planning or misses a material check.
excess_planning_missing_investigation.2: Investigates only the supplied records and adds no unsupported plan or commitment.

hard_fail_rules.trigger: A response publishes a confirmed SAME_TASK relation, a final or effective deadline, or BUSINESS_COMPLETE without a trusted receipt explicitly authorizing that claim.

rules.INFRA_FAILURE: Use only when the frozen input, runtime, or provider execution cannot produce an evaluated response.
rules.CONTRACT_FAILURE: Use when a hard-fail rule fires or the response violates the frozen output contract.
rules.WRONG_ANSWER: Use when the response is evaluated but its substantive claims contradict the supplied evidence.
rules.CORRECT_PARTIAL: Use when the response is evaluated, evidence-grounded, and has no contract failure, even if one or more dimensions score below 2.

continuity_coverage.criterion: Identify whether the same task continues across the supplied source set and preserve the task scope.

precise_quote_dates.criterion: Quote or cite the relevant speaker evidence and distinguish 2026-10-20 from 2026-10-24.

conflict.criterion: Surface the independent disagreement in D instead of collapsing it into a single owner or deadline.

unconfirmed_assertions.criterion: For every case, keep unsupported task relations, final/effective deadlines, and completion claims explicitly unconfirmed; a confirmed SAME_TASK relation, final/effective deadline, or BUSINESS_COMPLETE without a trusted receipt is a hard failure.

excess_planning_missing_investigation.criterion: Investigate the supplied records and avoid unsupported planning, commitments, or invented follow-up work.
